C-SOURCE-HISTORY-OWNERSHIP.IntentSummary: Give ordinary Source each live document lifetime its own CodeMirror document and history, preserving undo/redo on tab return and excluding foreign import history.
C-SOURCE-HISTORY-OWNERSHIP.ReferenceState: Prepared on main 4fa3cffa813445e1e6974a5ac8283f54abf89e5c on 2026-11-11. The specification is approved; this completed plan remains draft until explicit owner approval. No runtime writes have begun.
C-SOURCE-HISTORY-OWNERSHIP.Coordination: Execute sequentially after C-SPLIT-SAVE-AUTHORITY has passed final, received explicit apply confirmation and been archived. Re-run current and the selected baseline against that exact resulting state. Preserve the completed Split repair and its immutable archive. Both bundles share source tests and M-011/M-012 projections; their evidence and approvals remain distinct.
C-SOURCE-HISTORY-OWNERSHIP.Architecture: Add sourceDocumentHistory.ts under M-011: createSourceDocumentHistory(store) returns a registry for a renderer editor store, keyed by id plus existing documentToken. Bind a distinct actual CodeMirror.Doc per ordinary live lifetime and use cm.swapDoc rather than importing another tab through setValue into one shared history. Retain detached docs and their own selections/history while tabs remain live; detach on Source component unmount so remount can rebind safely. Registry access is scoped to the store via a WeakMap, not persisted on serializable tabs. Prune against live owners on close/token replacement; discard a cached doc on canonical content replacement or unified-history adoption. CodeMirror history generations are not saved-state authority: preserve tab.savedMarkdown/savedFormat and the existing correlated ACK recomputation.
C-SOURCE-HISTORY-OWNERSHIP.CommandBudgets: Reference host measurements on unchanged 4fa3cffa: seven existing suites / 100 tests in 2.93 seconds (the Source command including its not-yet-created test filter in 2.84 seconds), IPC typecheck 0.17 seconds, renderer build 7.98 seconds. Budgets are 30 / 10 / 45 seconds with execution headroom; preserve these budgets and existing product/test deadlines. The new Source helper tests must exist and execute after implementation; the baseline measurement is not regression proof. Full coverage and browser/native startup belong to acceptance, not nested MustPassCommand gates.

T-001.Title: Introduce lifetime-scoped ordinary Source documents and integrate the real adapter

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Before runtime changes, update the Source file contract and M-011/M-012 graph/verification target descriptions. Add failing-first mounted Source regressions: A then fresh B, first native CodeMirror undo/redo leaves B unchanged and selected pathname B. Demonstrate the failure on the unchanged ordinary Source baseline and preserve the receipt.

Define createSourceDocumentHistory(store) with bind(cm, owner, markdown), retain(liveOwners), release(cm) and retire(owner). owner is { id, documentToken }; bind returns the incoming document binding and its actual rendered serialization. Use CodeMirror.Doc/getDoc/swapDoc internally and preserve native history, redo branches and reversed selections. A new Doc starts from incoming text with no import undo entry. No pathname-only lookup, token minting or disk/session persistence.

Integrate registry bind at initial mount and handleFileChange. Commit outgoing content/caret only for the still-live rendered owner before detaching it; stale, unrelated and retired incoming events cannot rebind the active pane. Watch id AND documentToken, and prune retained docs when live owners change. Detach the active doc during unmount after the existing outgoing commit. Source serialization follows its own bound Doc, preserving exact source syntax and format metadata.

Treat contentReloaded/new lifetime or a canonical replacement inconsistent with cached rendered text as a fresh binding; compare normalized CodeMirror text without rewriting canonical bytes. Unified tabs continue with the existing Muya bus undo/redo, zero CodeMirror undo depth and composition guards; retire the ordinary cache upon unified adoption so it cannot restore an obsolete branch.

Add tests/renderer/util/source-document-history.test.js using actual CodeMirror.Doc history, not a handwritten stack model: two edits plus a redo branch in A, B edits, A return, independent B return; reversed selection; saved checkpoint remains truthful; same path/new token; same id/new token; close pruning; external replacement; unmount/remount; unified adoption; pending outgoing event; composition; mirror and locked controls. Keep mounted integration tests in the existing Source suites and update their adapter doubles only to model the used public APIs.

T-002.Title: Verify ordinary undo and stream boundaries in the built renderer

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Extend source-code-mode.spec.ts with actual keyboard undo/redo on fresh B after A and with A1/A2/undo then B edit then A return/redo/undo. Check complete displayed text, store text, selected pathname, saved checkpoint and save payload. Closing/reopening the same path must have a fresh token and no old undo. Exercise Source unmount/remount and transitions to unified Split without importing retired ordinary history.

Extend live-stream-ownership.spec.ts to invoke actual CodeMirror keyboard undo/redo after stream open, patch, close and a late patch; cover autosave off and on. Assert absence of foreign text in every visible intermediate state and each write, not just serialized tab.history. Run the existing rich/source/Split modes and in-flight ACK case without weakened timers, retries or thresholds.

Run full renderer coverage and the browser commands on this worktree's owned built preview. The live-stream suite also runs WebKit; dedicated native checks cover ordinary Source in WKWebView. Browser doubles never establish real IPC or native disk acceptance.

T-003.Title: Prove native history retention and complete the combined local document matrix

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Build a fresh isolated app with both repairs. Repeat fresh ordinary Source A to B first-undo; A two edits/redo branch to B edit to A return; same-path close/reopen; Source remount/unified transitions. Observe exact visible text and pathname at every undo/redo step and compare independent disk bytes.

Using the real native stream server, repeat rich/source/Split times autosave on/off times background-switch/close-late-patch, with new local edits, local undo/redo and native Save. In autosave-off cases prove disk unchanged until Save, then exact expected bytes; in autosave-on cases prove exact expected bytes after the unchanged delay. Repeat Split Source-to-Split rich authority and Standard controls so the history repair cannot regress the first bundle.

Record the source tree/diff, bundle, SHA-256, actual cases and failure dispositions in .claude/native-repair/source-acceptance.md. Record owner verdicts separately; retain pending Windows native and credential-store-failure gaps. Reconcile only M-011/M-012 and V-M-011/V-M-012 projections, run selected final with leaf commands externally, and request explicit apply confirmation before archive. Release remains unauthorized.
